replies.author: _Gill
replies.body:
Basically, everything you guys are suggesting isn't necessary. Its a lot of extra work for something that a simple email does easily. Also, the reason we don't have both is because we prefer just a uniform place to do appeals. It would be annoying to constantly be checking both the forums and email to see who we should unban.

And really whats so difficult about an email? You WILL need one later than life, so why not get one now? It will save you hours in the future, and is just convenient. There is no reason to change from the email system. Also, creating an email account is free, just why not make one? Simple as that.

My final point is that to be honest, I don't really care about how convenient appealing is for someone that breaks the rules on this server. Unless you're planning on getting banned soon (have fun), then this doesn't affect you. 

So my final question is, why does everyone make such a big fuss out of this? And why is it such a big deal to the average forum user?
